description: One change request (CR-3310) touching a controller, a service implementation, a Spring Data repository interface with @Query methods and a static utility class. Four test classes are pasted separately: a JUnit 5 @WebMvcTest, a JUnit 4 Mockito test (@RunWith(MockitoJUnitRunner.class), @Before, @Test(expected = ...)), a @DataJpaTest repository test and a JUnit 5 utility test that accidentally contains one JUnit 4 @org.junit.Test method. Scope is `git diff --name-status` output with M/A/D/R lines, a deleted class and non-Java files (.sql, .properties, pom.xml). The JaCoCo XML (pretty-printed) and the matching JaCoCo CSV cover only InvoiceServiceImpl and InvoiceNumberUtils: the changed InvoiceController is entirely missing from the report.

quality.note: @Test(expected = Exception.class): passes for any exception (even an NPE), not specifically the IllegalArgumentException the code throws.
Annotated with the JUnit 4 @org.junit.Test (fully qualified) inside an otherwise JUnit 5 class.
Jupiter ignores @org.junit.Test; the Vintage engine would reject it because neither the class nor the method is public. The test never runs.

notes: jacoco.missingChangedClasses (extension key) lists changed production classes that have executable code but no <class> element in the report. InvoiceController is changed (M) and has code, yet is absent: its coverage is NOT VERIFIED, it must not be shown as 0% or 100%.

InvoiceRepository is a Spring Data interface with no default methods, so it has no bytecode and is legitimately absent from JaCoCo; it should not be reported as missing coverage (it is exercised by the @DataJpaTest instead).
LegacyInvoiceNumberGenerator.java is deleted (D): it appears in changedFiles but not in changedProductionClasses and must not be expected in JaCoCo.

Rename line "R087<TAB>old<TAB>new": changedFiles lists only the new path (InvoiceServiceImplTest.java); the old path .../service/InvoiceServiceTest.java no longer exists. R087 is the similarity score, not part of the path.
Non-Java changes (V42__invoice_sequence.sql, application.properties, pom.xml) and src/test/java files are in changedFiles but are not production classes.
The name-status paste uses real TAB separators between status and path(s).

11-jacococsv-invoicing.txt is the same report as 10-jacoco-invoicing.txt in JaCoCo CSV form (GROUP,PACKAGE,CLASS,... with dotted package names); per-class numbers must agree with the XML. CSV carries no LINE-level detail and no report totals row.

JUnit 4 tests using @Test(expected = X.class) (findByNumber_unknown_throwsNotFound, findByNumber_malformed, recordPayment_overpayment_isRejected) contain no assert call but expected= is the assertion; they must NOT be reported as NO_ASSERTION.
isValidRejects runs 5 invocations (@NullAndEmptySource contributes null and "" in addition to the 3 @ValueSource strings); formatRejectsNonPositiveSequence runs 2.
InvoiceController uses the wildcard import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.* (mapping annotations must still be recognised) and a fully-qualified parameter type java.math.BigDecimal in pay().

Strings/comments that must not confuse a parser: InvoiceRepository line 19 is a // comment containing braces; the @Query JPQL on lines 15-16 is a concatenated string containing ":cutoff" and "<"; InvoiceNumberUtils Javadoc line 10 contains "{PREFIX}-{yyyyMM}" and the regex literal on line 15 contains "{3}" quantifiers and escaped backslashes; InvoiceRepositoryTest line 48 has an @Sql statement string containing ";" and "--".

InvoiceNumberUtils has a private empty constructor (line 17) which JaCoCo filters, so no <init> appears for it; checkDigit is package-private and is covered indirectly (format/isValid) even though its only direct test never runs.

Uncovered: InvoiceServiceImpl.findOverdue (line 57, METHOD missed=1), the PAID/VOID guard throw (line 65) and the non-positive amount throw (line 68); InvoiceNumberUtils.parseSequence (line 46, METHOD missed=1). Partial branches: InvoiceServiceImpl 40 (termDays ternary), 64 and 67 (two || conditions each only evaluated false), InvoiceNumberUtils 21 (sequence > 999_999 never true).
